section3.title: 3. Frequently Asked Questions on PPE Certification

item1.q: What is the difference between WHS regulations and AS/NZS standards?
item1.a: WHS regulations set the mandatory legal safety requirements in Australia, while AS/NZS standards provide technical specifications and testing methods for PPE.

item2.q: Can I utilise US (ANSI) or European (CE) certified PPE in Australian workplaces?
item2.a: Not automatically. PPE used in Australia must meet the specific AS/NZS standards required by WHS laws, although some international standards are recognised as equivalent.

item3.a: While the equipment has a manufacturer's lifespan, employers must ensure PPE remains compliant with the current AS/NZS version if standards are updated.

item4.q: How do I verify certified PPE?
item4.a: Look for the specific AS/NZS standard marking or the 'Five Ticks' Standards Mark stamped directly on the equipment or its packaging.
